parole.significato: A plant related to the thistle with enlarged flower heads eaten as a vegetable while immature, Cynara cardunculus var.…
parole.testo: From Lombard articioch (cf. articiocco), from Occitan artichaut, from Old Spanish alcarchofa, from Andalusian Arabic الْخَرْشُوف (al-ḵaršúf), from Arabic الْخُرْشُوف (al-ḵuršūf), definite form of خُرْشُوف (ḵuršūf).

parole.significato: A stringed instrument built by members of the Stradivari family, particularly Antonio Stradivari.
parole.testo: Named after the Stradivari family (Latin Stradivarius), an Italian surname either from the plural of Lombard stradivare (“toll-man”), or from strada averta (“open road”) in the Cremonese dialect.
